Step-up validation confirmed the customer was not in the vicinity of the merchant at the time of the transaction despite possessing the physical card. The case is classified as fraud due to suspected card cloning or unauthorized use in a different geographic region.

sar.reason: Confirmed unauthorized in-person transaction suggesting card cloning.
sar.narrative: Customer C08623 contacted the bank to report an unrecognized transaction of $49.00 on card C08623-K2. The transaction, ID 3530164, occurred on 2016-12-10 at 13:01:21. Internal records indicate the transaction was processed as an in-person, card-present event. The transaction originated from a location identified by address codes 330 and 87. A Tier 2 investigation was initiated due to the discrepancy between the customer's location and the transaction's point of sale. Step-up authentication was performed, and the customer confirmed they were not in the specified region during the time of the transaction. The customer further confirmed that the physical card remained in their possession at all times. This pattern of activity is consistent with card cloning or the use of a counterfeit card. The transaction has been flagged as fraudulent and the card has been restricted to prevent further loss. Total exposure is limited to the single transaction of $49.00.

stop_reason: Fraud confirmed through customer validation and geographic discrepancy.
